caveat: This is a design sensitivity calculation, not post-hoc observed power. The confirmatory interval still resamples prompts nonparametrically.
interpretation: Under the stated clustering and pairing assumptions, the full test is designed for about a 5.6-point effect at a 20% baseline rate; the variance-maximizing 50% case is 7.0 points.
method: Normal approximation for a paired mean of prompt-level domain-rate differences with beta-binomial-style design effect
